notes: Driver = title (no predicate); all 2528312 movies enter the loop but most die at mk probe (kw_ids selectivity ~5e-5).
Fact probe order chosen by cheapest+most-selective first: mk → mi_idx → mi → ci.
All fact probes use index_nested_loop with offsets — no hash join build; cache-friendly sequential scans within per-movie ranges.

Early exit per fact: once one qualifying row is found, we have semi-match BUT must still scan all rows for MIN projection of that fact's projected column (mi.info, mi_idx.info, ci → n.name). So semi-exit only after fact has been fully scanned to update running min.

Important: for MIN correctness we cannot early-exit on first qualifying row per fact for the projected column — must scan full per-movie range for mi, mi_idx, ci. Early-exit applies to gating (whether movie survives), tracked by a boolean.
